description: Adds email addresses to a site's list and emails each new one an invitation from the account. Use only addresses the person gave you — never guess, infer or look one up. `comment` lets them comment as well as open it. Inviting does not make the site private; update_site's `invitedOnly: true` does. On plans with private sharing; all or nothing — one bad address, or a list past the plan's limit, adds nobody.

emails.description: The addresses, exactly as the person gave them.

role.description: `view` (the default) to open the site, `comment` to open it and comment.

site.description: Subdomain or site id, from list_sites.

name: invite_people

alreadyListed.description: Addresses already on the list, left as they were and not emailed again.

total.description: How many are on the list now.

title: Invite people to a site
